crossRefs.note: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were…

translations.web: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
translations.bsb: In addition to them, according to their genealogy, they had 36,000 troops for battle, for they had many wives and children.
translations.kjv: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
translations.asv: And with them, by their generations, after their fathers' houses, were bands of the host for war, six and thirty thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
